# HR Policy Handbook

## Annual Leave

Full-time employees receive 15 paid annual leave days per calendar year. New employees who join after July 1 receive 7 annual leave days for that first calendar year. Unused annual leave can carry over to the next year, but the carryover limit is 5 days.

## Sick Leave

Employees receive 10 paid sick leave days per calendar year. A medical certificate is required when sick leave lasts more than 2 consecutive workdays.

## Remote Work

Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week with manager approval. Remote work from another country requires approval from HR and Security at least 10 business days before travel.

## Probation

New employees have a 3-month probation period. The manager must complete a probation review before the end of the third month.

## Employment Verification

Employees can request employment verification letters from HR Operations. Standard letters are issued within 3 business days. Letters that include salary details require written employee consent.

# Expense Reimbursement Policy

## Meal Expenses

Meal reimbursement requires an itemized receipt. The daily meal limit is 60 USD for domestic travel and 90 USD for international travel. Alcohol is not reimbursable unless pre-approved for a client event.

## Lodging

Hotel reimbursement is capped at 220 USD per night for domestic travel and 300 USD per night for international travel. Exceptions require director approval before booking.

## Transportation

Economy class is required for flights under 6 hours. Premium economy may be booked for flights of 6 hours or more with manager approval. Business class requires VP approval regardless of flight duration.

## Submission Deadline

Expense reports must be submitted within 30 calendar days after the trip ends. Reports submitted after 30 days require finance manager approval.

## Missing Receipts

If a receipt is missing, employees must submit a missing receipt declaration. Declarations are limited to 3 uses per quarter. Expenses above 100 USD still require finance approval when the original receipt is unavailable.

# Information Security Policy

## Passwords

Passwords must be at least 14 characters long. Passwords must not be reused across company and personal accounts. Password managers are approved for storing work credentials.

## Multi-Factor Authentication

Multi-factor authentication is required for email, VPN, source code repositories, finance systems, and production infrastructure. Hardware security keys are required for privileged administrator accounts.

## Data Classification

Hardware security keys are required for privileged administrator accounts.

## Data Classification

Company data is classified as Public, Internal, Confidential, or Restricted. Customer personal data is Restricted. Product roadmap documents are Confidential unless explicitly approved for public release.

## Incident Reporting

Suspected security incidents must be reported to the Security team within 1 hour.

cident Reporting

Suspected security incidents must be reported to the Security team within 1 hour. Lost or stolen company devices must be reported immediately, even if the device is encrypted.

## Vendor Access

Vendor access to internal systems requires a named business owner, a signed data processing agreement, and an expiration date. Vendor accounts must be reviewed every 90 days.

# Acme Knowledge Assistant FAQ

## Supported Sources

Acme Knowledge Assistant can ingest Markdown, plain text, PDF files with embedded text, and DOCX documents. Scanned PDFs are not supported unless OCR is performed before upload.

## Synchronization

The system checks connected source folders every 4 hours. Manual synchronization can be started by an administrator from the admin console. Deleted source files are removed from search results after the next successful sync.

## Answer Citations

Every generated answer should include citations to the source chunks used. If no relevant source is found, the assistant should say that the knowledge base does not contain a reliable answer.

## Access Control

Search results must respect document permissions. Users should only retrieve chunks from documents they are allowed to view.

## Limits

The recommended single document size limit is 25 MB. The recommended maximum chunk size is 800 tokens. Very large documents should be split by section before upload when possible.
